{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gold Plaza''' was a bare, open-aired square paved in small white tiles. It was where [[Clog-dweller]]s and [[Stones-dweller|Stone-dwellers]] met to arrange employment.

It was here that [[Tag Rayor]] met a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to sell the [[Black Sphere]]. He was ambushed and killed by [[Falad Prok]].
